title: Clean screen, status, menus and function keys
acceptance_probe: Replay start, edit, nested menus, cancel and exit; record screen and prompts.

title: Context-sensitive help
acceptance_probe: Open help from document and nested dialogs; return to the previous state.

title: Original keyboard layouts and remapping
acceptance_probe: Load, edit, persist and exercise keyboard definitions.

title: Mouse interactions
acceptance_probe: Exercise original menu and selection actions with terminal event mapping recorded.

title: Display configuration and screen type
acceptance_probe: Compare text attributes, display pitch, dimensions and graphics capabilities.

title: Two-document switching and windows
acceptance_probe: Switch and split documents; verify independent cursor and formatting state.

title: Cancel and command repetition
acceptance_probe: Cancel at multiple prompt depths; repeat input and commands.

title: Cursor movement and go-to
acceptance_probe: Move across text, codes, pages and subdocuments; compare cursor positions.

title: Block selection and protection
acceptance_probe: Select original block types and test protection during editing and reflow.

title: Copy, move and append
acceptance_probe: Copy or move selections and append to new/existing files with codes intact.

title: Text deletion and restoration
acceptance_probe: Compare deletion units and three-entry undelete behavior including paired codes.

title: Insert versus typeover
acceptance_probe: Type across text and formatting codes; verify codes are not overwritten.

title: Reveal Codes
acceptance_probe: Toggle Alt-F3; move/delete in the code pane and compare effects in the normal pane.

title: Search and replacement
acceptance_probe: Exercise text/code searches, direction, case and extended subdocument replacement.

title: Case changes and repeat input
acceptance_probe: Apply commands to text and blocks; compare boundaries and formatting.

title: Hard and soft returns and spaces
acceptance_probe: Distinguish explicit paragraph boundaries from reflow; preserve code identity.

title: Line-drawing text
acceptance_probe: Create and modify line-drawing structures without corrupting text or characters.

title: Refresh and reformat
acceptance_probe: Trigger rewrite and inspect layout and cursor effects.

title: Retrieve and insert documents
acceptance_probe: Retrieve whole documents and blocks, preserving their codes and resource references.

title: Native save and overwrite workflow
acceptance_probe: Save F10; verify filename editing, overwrite confirmation and initial codes.

title: Original and timed backups
acceptance_probe: Exercise both existing backup modes and recovery behavior; compare artifacts.

title: Fast Save
acceptance_probe: Compare saved bytes and formatting with the option enabled and disabled.

title: File lists, directories and resource locations
acceptance_probe: Replay file operations and path resolution with explicit Linux mapping.

title: Password-locked documents
acceptance_probe: Open and save correct/wrong-password fixtures without touching the original on failure.

title: Original text import/export modes
acceptance_probe: Compare each original mode, encoding and documented losses.

title: Original 4.2 conversion modes
acceptance_probe: Compare both conversion directions using original-version fixtures.

title: Document comments and comparison
acceptance_probe: Persist comments and compare documents, inspecting marked changes.

title: Document look/find operations
acceptance_probe: Exercise file-content inspection and conditional file finding.

title: Exit and save decisions
acceptance_probe: Replay saved/modified/unnamed documents through all exit decisions.

title: Attributes and change markings
acceptance_probe: Apply/remove attributes and redline/strikeout; inspect paired codes and print results.

title: Fonts and kerning
acceptance_probe: Compare font changes, sizes, printer substitutions and kerning with fixed resources.

title: Initial document and application codes
acceptance_probe: Distinguish default settings from document initial codes and saved state.

title: Margins and format menus
acceptance_probe: Change line/page/document defaults and verify their code scope.

title: Alignment, centering and indents
acceptance_probe: Compare centered/right-aligned/justified text and indents across reflow.

title: Tabs and tab alignment
acceptance_probe: Set tab types, alignment and leaders; verify native codes and layout.

title: Line height, spacing and numbering
acceptance_probe: Combine proportional fonts, line height, spacing and line numbers.

title: Word/letter spacing and measurement units
acceptance_probe: Check unit conversion and spacing without cumulative layout drift.

title: Precise positioning and advance
acceptance_probe: Compare absolute/relative advances, page limits and text-box origins.

title: Hyphenation and zones
acceptance_probe: Compare word breaking, zones, manual decisions and saved codes.

title: Hard/soft pages and conditional breaks
acceptance_probe: Reflow through hard, soft, conditional and odd/even page transitions.

title: Page numbering and paper definitions
acceptance_probe: Use paper definitions and page numbering across format changes.

title: Keep-together and widow/orphan rules
acceptance_probe: Force borderline pagination and compare page membership.

title: Columns and screen column presentation
acceptance_probe: Compare newspaper and parallel columns, breaks, balancing and display.

title: Headers, footers and suppression
acceptance_probe: Create header/footer variants; compare suppression and page-dependent placement.

title: Footnotes and endnotes
acceptance_probe: Test nested text, numbering, continuation and pagination.

title: Styles and definitions
acceptance_probe: Create and apply styles, edit definitions and compare resulting code scope.

title: Outlines and numbering
acceptance_probe: Create, redefine, promote/demote and restyle outline levels.

title: Tables and structural editing
acceptance_probe: Create tables; edit rows, columns, joins and splits; preserve native structure.

title: Table formatting and calculations
acceptance_probe: Compare cell/column formatting, formulas and recalculation.

title: Generated contents, lists and index

title: Table of authorities
acceptance_probe: Mark citations, define categories and regenerate with original ordering.

title: Master documents and subdocuments
acceptance_probe: Expand/condense subdocuments and regenerate references across them.

title: Labels and envelopes
acceptance_probe: Compare definitions, repeated labels and envelope placement with fixed printer settings.

title: Date values and codes
acceptance_probe: Compare inserted values and generated dates under fixed clock and language settings.

title: Graphics boxes, wrapping and captions

title: Graphics formats and conversion utility
acceptance_probe: Reproduce original import/conversion behavior and preserve embedded/linked resources.

title: Graphic rules and display options
acceptance_probe: Compare rules, boxes, display settings and printed placement.

title: Equations and equation editor
acceptance_probe: Edit equation expressions and compare native representation and rendering.

title: Macro definition, execution and editor

acceptance_probe: Catalogue and test each command, expression, variable and value-table behavior.

acceptance_probe: Compare supported original conversions and unsupported-input handling.

title: Merge documents, data and commands

title: Sorting and record selection
acceptance_probe: Compare keys, ordering, selected records and preservation of fields/codes.

title: Column math and calculations
acceptance_probe: Define columns and functions; compare arithmetic results and formatting.

title: Spreadsheet import and links
acceptance_probe: Import supported worksheets; update links and compare data/format refresh behavior.

title: WP characters and compose
acceptance_probe: Input original character-set identities and round-trip every supported mapping.

title: Language selection and resources
acceptance_probe: Switch language-dependent formatting and resources; record edition applicability.

title: Spelling, dictionaries, lookup and counts
acceptance_probe: Check corrections, dictionaries, lookup, counts and original utility behavior.

title: Thesaurus
acceptance_probe: Compare lookup, replacement and return-to-editor workflow using declared resources.

title: Print selection, options and quality
acceptance_probe: Print documents, pages and blocks; compare copies, quality, ordering and stopping.

title: Printer selection and editing
acceptance_probe: Select/edit original printer settings; preserve resource references and metrics.

title: Printer commands and functions
acceptance_probe: Exercise direct commands and layout-affecting printer controls.

title: Printer-definition utility and fonts
acceptance_probe: Inventory resource-editing and substitution behavior; define Linux equivalent explicitly.

title: Printing to disk
acceptance_probe: Compare original printer-language output bytes with matching resources.

title: Print jobs and delivery
acceptance_probe: Inspect, cancel and prioritize jobs; map delivery to Linux without changing print data.

title: Document preview and options
acceptance_probe: Compare page view and facing pages using declared printer metrics.

title: Setup, environment and sound
acceptance_probe: Persist original settings and document Linux adaptations.

title: DOS and shell integration
acceptance_probe: Inventory external-process workflows and define explicit Linux mappings.

title: Bundled conversion, cursor and capture utilities
acceptance_probe: Study utility boundaries and original artifact behavior before choosing Linux implementation.

title: Memory and startup controls
acceptance_probe: Classify original startup and memory controls; record hardware-only adaptations.

title: Network and original resource files
acceptance_probe: Inventory shared-file behavior, locking, resource discovery and companion formats.

title: Code tables, defaults, keyboards and errors
acceptance_probe: Reconcile appendices against feature coverage and negative scenarios.

title: File prefix and document pointer
acceptance_probe: Check identifiers, versions, byte order, encryption marker and document pointer against original files.

title: Prefix index chains and packets
acceptance_probe: Preserve packet bytes and references while testing bounds, cycles and relocations.

title: Document code framing and nested text
acceptance_probe: Validate fixed/variable frames, nested codes and unknown-code preservation.

title: Original character and function encoding
acceptance_probe: Check every defined code class against fixtures, including hard/soft boundary codes.

title: Formatting, structure and automation code groups
acceptance_probe: Map every WP code group to semantic behavior and round-trip fixtures.

title: Native WPM macro serialization
acceptance_probe: Read/write macro headers and command encodings with original interpreter evidence.
